name: Copenhagenize Index of bicycle-friendly cities

vetted.notes: An expert ranking of how cities serve cyclists; all rights reserved, so a link only. The open cycling lines are the OpenStreetMap cycle network and the official share of trips to work by bicycle.

personalUse: For a person to read. Automated reading (an agent fetching the page) needs the publisher's permission; a figure the person reads there and gives their agent may be kept in that person's cache with the page's address, never committed or published.
